**Root cause found in `src/main/resources/application.properties`, line 11.**

The `delivery` and `alert` handler mappings are swapped:

```properties
# BUGGY (current)
notification.handlers.delivery=com.example.demo.bug1.AuditHandler   ← wrong
notification.handlers.alert=com.example.demo.bug1.DeliveryHandler    ← wrong

# FIXED
notification.handlers.delivery=com.example.demo.bug1.DeliveryHandler
notification.handlers.alert=com.example.demo.bug1.AuditHandler
```

`NotificationService2.dispatch()` loads the handler class from config at startup (via `HandlerConfig` + `@ConfigurationProperties`). For a `DELIVERY` event, it resolves `AuditHandler`, instantiates it via reflection, and calls `handle()` — which writes an audit log entry instead of sending a delivery confirmation. No exception is thrown because `AuditHandler` implements the same `EventHandler` interface and runs silently.
